source: Fully Playable Young Sephiroth (Create a Character System 3.8): Young Sephiroth in Cloud's slot, on his own skeleton (PC0010_13_Skeleton, Rebirth's bone names) in the family of Sephiroth's, with Sephiroth's moves and the Fully Playable Sephiroth's forms menu (hold Triangle: YOUNG SEPHIROTH, OLDER SEPHIROTH, WINGED, FLYING, KH2, BIZARRO, SAFER). YOUNG SEPHIROTH, his normal form, has his base abilities plus wing and flying ones: PC0010_AtkBurst01, PC0010_AtkBurst02, PC0010_T_ShadowFlare, PC0010_T_HardCombo, PC0010_T_WarpStab; his weapons give T_Blizzaga, W3_InfernalGate, T_Aeroga, W3_SwordDance, T_OctaslashPrime, W2_ZanshinRising and T_Thundaga (the casts and the warp stab come from the transformed Sephiroth's sets). OLDER SEPHIROTH: his normal form's moves and abilities as the game's own Sephiroth (PC0010_15 in YoungSephiroth_P, a copy of Rebirth's PC0010_00 that KH2Sephiroth_P does not replace), with the real Masamune. Goes with FullyPlayableYoungSephirothDataAssets_P and YoungSephiroth_P; the Fully Playable Sephiroth's SephirothForms.json switches off by itself without its pak. Based on: Sephiroth's forms on Cloud's ability IDs (Create a Character System 3.6): your playable Sephiroth (Cloud's rows, including the prologue's Cloud in Zack's SOLDIER outfit) has six forms on the forms menu (hold Triangle in battle, pick one with up / down, let go): NORMAL (Battle00), WINGED (Battle02 = the transformed Sephiroth's Battle00), FLYING (Battle03 = his Battle01 wing moves, then his Battle00; it also comes by itself after Heartless Angel), KH2 (Battle04: his Kingdom Hearts II moves) and BIZARRO (Battle05: he becomes Bizarro Sephiroth, with Bizarro's attacks as his commands and in place of his weapon abilities, his moves made of Bizarro's animations, Bizarro's conjured sword in his sword attacks, super armor; it lasts 60 s, then 30 s before it can be chosen again). The sixth form is SAFER (Battle06: he becomes Safer Sephiroth, his model and his own AnimBlueprint from FullyPlayableSephirothDataAssets_P, his moves made of Safer's animations with his hits struck from Safer's wing, hand and body, his walks and runs Safer's idle leaning into Sephiroth's flying locomotion; super armor; it lasts 60 s, then 30 s before it can be chosen again). His limits are Cloud's (level 1 Octaslash, 2 Heartless Angel, 3 Meteor: they unlock like Cloud's), the abilities Cloud's weapons give are his moves and switch with the form (weapon_abilities), and each form has its own ATB commands. His rows load the transformed Sephiroth's and Bizarro's effects (pack_assets) and the Fire/Blizzard/Thunder/Aero ability resources (preload). Goes with FullyPlayableSephirothDataAssets_P (his abilities, limits, damage and rows, the built moves, Safer's model, the wings' model). Field sets (Neutral00, Neutral20, Emotion00, Facial00): his own first, then Cloud's. Summons: Cloud's summon cast (B_MagSummon01) in every form but BIZARRO. In SAFER his commands are Bizarro's abilities (Bizarro's animations moving his upper body as the little Sephiroth on Bizarro's head moves), and switching to it plays his entrance: a white flash, he comes down from the sky in his cutscene animation, the camera low and looking up at him, ending close on his face. Switching to BIZARRO plays his transformation cutscene's ending: Sephiroth says "Alone at last. Shall we?" in the cutscene's close-up and camera, the darkness takes him, a white flash, and Bizarro Sephiroth rises into view with the cutscene's camera, animation, effects and sound (any ability skips it; the switch still happens). (Young Sephiroth: his wing is part of his own model, the PC0010_10_Wing slot the forms show in WINGED, FLYING and KH2; in KH2 he turns into KH2 Sephiroth, /Game/Character/Player/PC0010_14_Sephiroth_KH2/Model/PC0010_14 from KH2Sephiroth_P: without it he keeps his own model; he fights with the Nameless, and with the Masamune in WINGED, FLYING and KH2: "weapon", Create a Character System 3.8.2.) The young forms' switch lines are his own voice (VO_PC0010_13_YoungSephiroth in YoungSephirothVoice_P: Sephiroth's lines made younger); OLDER SEPHIROTH, KH2, BIZARRO and SAFER speak with adult Sephiroth's. (Create a Character System 3.9.0 "voice": the voice lines of his moves are his own young voice in YOUNG SEPHIROTH, WINGED and FLYING and in the field, Sephiroth's in OLDER SEPHIROTH, KH2, BIZARRO and SAFER.) (Create a Character System 3.9.1 "looks_from": the Toad status turns him into the frog Cloud turns into: Sephiroth's blueprint has no frog.) (Create a Character System 3.9.3: WINGED has every ATB ability FLYING has, on pages of 5 (L1 / R1); the forms' Masamune wears the PC0010_10 boss's sword aura.) (Create a Character System 3.11.4: REMAKE and REMAKE WINGED, at the end of the forms menu: he becomes FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE's Sephiroth, its model from CreateACharacterSkins_P (without it he keeps his own), and fights with Remake Sephiroth's own moves: his combo the boss's Assault chain and full-moon slash, his hold Square Ichijin (on the ground and in the air), each of its two slashes loosing one of Bizarro Sephiroth's Zanshin waves, his spells cast as Remake's, and his ATB commands Remake's Octaslash, Scintilla, Shadow Flare, Hell's Gate and Heartless Angel (Battle08); REMAKE WINGED (Battle09) wears Remake's winged Sephiroth, his black wing included, with the winged phase's Shadow Flare and Heartless Angel. The moves are in the data container.) (Create a Character System 3.12: YOUNG SEPHIROTH fights with his own Ever Crisis moves (Battle07): his combo, air combo, abilities, limits, casts, items and summons, idle, run, reactions, death and victory are his own skills' motions, with Sephiroth's combo, cancel and dodge windows, damage, swings, trails and slashes on his blows; the rest of his moves are Sephiroth's. WINGED's moves play the transformed Sephiroth's feeler slashes, and Zanshin and Hell's Gate loose his feelers, out of the ground for Hell's Gate; the transformed casts show their effects for your abilities: Ground Feeler's feelers burst out of the ground. The moves are in the data container.) (CRISIS CORE (Battle10): Crisis Core Reunion Sephiroth in his own model, fighting with his own Crisis Core motions: his combo (the downward cut and sweep, the quick and lunging cuts, the rising and leaping cuts, the iaido dash), hold Square (the rising thrust), Triangle (the leap and plunge), his limit (Octaslash), casts, idle, damage and victory, with Sephiroth's combo, cancel and dodge windows and damage on his blows, the Masamune's trail and swing on every slash; the rest of his moves are Sephiroth's. The moves are in the data container.)
